# localId: # One row per ARVO case; every case is one PoC run against the single baseline tree
# coder        ImageMagick coder name handed to the reproducer at run time
# sanitizer    which instrumented reproducer runs this case (address|undefined|memory)
# alert        ARVO crash_type of the case, verbatim; what verify-one compares the
#              sanitizer report against, and what reports/*.json carries as "alert"
# expect_frame ARVO #0 function (informational: the SUMMARY wording varies on replay)
# patch        this case's single fix patch, relative to /payload; verify-one.sh applies
#              exactly that one patch on top of the baseline and expects a clean run
# fix_commit   upstream commit that fixes the case; 68 cases -> 62 unique patches
